sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 588 of 2023

Applicant :- Salman
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mrs.Suniti Sachan,Divya Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Rajesh Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State.

2.  This is second bail application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in case crime No.508 of 2021 under Section 376-D, 343, 506 IPC, PS Mohammadpur Khala, district Barabanki.

The first bail application Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.5672 of 2022 was rejected by Hon'ble Mr.
Justice Krishan Pahal, J. on 2.6.2022.
3.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.5672 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that medical report does not support the prosecution case and no injury has been found on the person of prosecutrix, no opinion of rape was given by the doctor.
She has further submitted that there is delay of three months in lodging FIR.
She has stated that it is a case of consent, therefore, the applicant is liable to be released on bail.

sentences.text:

1 has further submitted that co-accused Anees has been granted bail by this Court, therefore, it is a new cause of action and applicant is entitled for benefit of the said order.

4. On the other hand, learned AGA has opposed the bail and submitted that statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded in which she has assigned specific role of rape against the applicant whereas, she has not assigned any role of rape against co-accused Anees.
He has submitted that it is not a case at par with the case of co-accused Anees.
In her statement under Section 164 also she has levelled allegation of rape.
He has submitted that the bail application is liable to be rejected.

5. Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case, the prosecution has got recorded statement of prosecutrix before the Trial Court and she has specifically assigned role of rape against the applicant and she has not assigned role of any physical assault to co-accused Anees who has been granted bail, therefore, it is not a case where parity should be granted.

6. Therefore, the second bail application is rejected.
Order Date :- 18.5.2023 Rajneesh JR-PS)
